title: Positive, Negative, and Reliable Information in a First-Order Logic of Evidence and Truth
summary: In this paper we present the first-order logic QLETF+, a quantified version of the logic LETF+, introduced in Coniglio and Rodrigues (Studia Logica 112:561-606, 2024). QLETF+ exhibits several properties that are not always enjoyed by logics equipped with classicality operators. We show that it satisfies the replacement property and admits conjunctive, disjunctive, and prenex normal forms.
